name: Levoča, Spišský Hrad and the Associated Cultural Monuments
description: Spišský Hrad is a vast hilltop castle in eastern Slovakia, its Romanesque and Gothic walls and towers rising above the town of Spišské Podhradie. The listing also covers the walled medieval town of Levoča, whose church of St James holds ten 15th–16th century altars. Among them is Master Paul's Gothic altarpiece, about 18.6 metres high and finished around 1510.
